card.name: Start of the word APPROPRIATE
card.fires_on: The opening piece "App" of the word "appropriate", mostly in all-caps warning text. It fires right after phrases like "discontinued and", "withheld until" or "where".

modes.label: All-caps APPROPRIATE
modes.description: Capitalized "APP" starting APPROPRIATE in uppercase warning sections, before therapy or corrective measures.
modes.example: OTHER ALLERGENS. IF AN ALLERGIC REACTION OCCURS, PENICILLIN G SHOULD BE DISCONTINUED AND<< APP>>ROPRIATE THERAPY IN

modes.label: Sentence-initial Appropriate
modes.description: "App" starting the word "Appropriate" at the start of a sentence about fluid and electrolyte management.
modes.example: the administration of antibacterial agents. If CDAD is suspected or confirmed, ongoing antibiotic use not directed against C. difficile may need to be discontinued.<< App>>ropriate fluid and electrolyte management, protein

card.writes: It promotes app-like pieces, so it helps finish the word appropriate.
card.plain: It marks the first part of the word "appropriate" in label warnings, such as "appropriate therapy".
